## merge

Merge Conversation. `POST /conversations/{conversation_id}/merge`

Merge a source conversation into this one and reopen it.

The path conversation (conversation_id) SURVIVES and is reopened; the source_conversation_id from the body is merged in (all its messages, notes, tags, attachments, etc. move over) and then permanently deleted. Both conversations must belong to the SAME contact.

## snooze

Snooze Conversation. `POST /conversations/{conversation_id}/snooze`

Snooze (postpone) a conversation.

Snooze is a DERIVED state: the conversation status stays open / assigned — it simply drops off the Open tab and appears on the Snoozed tab until snoozed_until passes (query-time expiry, no background job). Once the timestamp passes it behaves like a normal open conversation again.

```php
$result = $sendseven->conversations()->snooze(conversationId: 'conversation_id', snoozedUntil: 'snoozed_until');
```

- Scopes: `conversations:update`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$conversationId` | `string` | yes |  |
| `$snoozedUntil` | `DateTimeInterface\|string` | yes | Timezone-aware ISO datetime when the snooze should expire. Must be in the future. After this moment the conversation behaves as a normal open conversation again. |
| `$reopenOnMessage` | `?bool` | no | When true, an inbound customer message arriving while the conversation is snoozed clears the snooze and returns it to the Open tab (handled by the inbound-message worker). |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `Conversation`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Conversations/snooze_conversation_api_v1_conversations__conversation_id__snooze_post)

## summarize

Summarize Conversation. `POST /conversations/{conversation_id}/summarize`

Manually trigger AI summary generation for a conversation.

```php
$sendseven->conversations()->summarize(conversationId: 'conversation_id');
```

- Scopes: `conversations:update`, `ai_features`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$conversationId` | `string` | yes |  |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `void`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Conversations/summarize_conversation_api_v1_conversations__conversation_id__summarize_post)

## getSummary

Get Conversation Summary. `GET /conversations/{conversation_id}/summary`

Full AI ticket summary for a single conversation, broken into the three sections the contact-page timeline renders on expand: user_intent, summary, resolution.

Lazy-loaded by the FE when a ticket_summary timeline row is expanded — the timeline list itself only carries a 140-char summary_preview to keep the list payload small. Reads the text directly off the Conversation SHARD row (no KB-doc / RAG fetch).

```php
$result = $sendseven->conversations()->getSummary(conversationId: 'conversation_id');
```

- Scopes: `knowledge_base:read`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$conversationId` | `string` | yes |  |

Returns `ConversationSummaryDetail`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Conversations/get_conversation_summary_api_v1_conversations__conversation_id__summary_get)

## switchChannel

Switch Channel. `POST /conversations/{conversation_id}/switch-channel`

Generate channel switch deeplinks for a conversation.

Accepts a list of channel_ids to generate links for specific channels, or omit to generate for all active switchable channels.

```php
$result = $sendseven->conversations()->switchChannel(conversationId: 'conversation_id');
```

- Scopes: `conversations:update`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$conversationId` | `string` | yes |  |
| `$channelIds` | `list<string>\|null` | no |  |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `ChannelSwitch`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Conversations/switch_channel_api_v1_conversations__conversation_id__switch_channel_post)

## getSwitchableChannels

Get Switchable Channels. `GET /conversations/{conversation_id}/switchable-channels`

List channels available for switching from this conversation.

Returns all active switchable channels (WhatsApp, Telegram, Messenger, Instagram) excluding the conversation's current channel. Used by the frontend to render a channel picker before generating deeplinks.

```php
$result = $sendseven->conversations()->getSwitchableChannels(conversationId: 'conversation_id');
```

- Scopes: `conversations:read`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$conversationId` | `string` | yes |  |

Returns `SwitchableChannels`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Conversations/get_switchable_channels_api_v1_conversations__conversation_id__switchable_channels_get)

## createTranscriptExport

Create Transcript Export. `POST /conversations/{conversation_id}/transcript`

Start an async transcript export (PDF or ZIP) for a conversation.

Creates a background job and returns it immediately with status queued (HTTP 202). Poll GET /conversations/{conversation_id}/transcript/{job_id} until status is completed (a download_url is then returned) or failed.

```php
$result = $sendseven->conversations()->createTranscriptExport(conversationId: 'conversation_id', format: 'format');
```

- Scopes: `conversations:read`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$conversationId` | `string` | yes |  |
| `$format` | `string` | yes | Export artifact format: 'pdf' (transcript only) or 'zip' (transcript + attachments). |
| `$waitForSummary` | `?bool` | no | If true, the worker waits for the conversation's AI summary (conversation.ai_summary) to be populated before rendering, so the generated transcript can include the summary at the top. Defaults to false (render immediately). Does NOT affect export deduplication — a given (conversation, format) yields the same artifact regardless. |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `TranscriptExportJob`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Conversations/create_transcript_export_api_v1_conversations__conversation_id__transcript_post)

## getTranscriptExport

Get Transcript Export. `GET /conversations/{conversation_id}/transcript/{job_id}`

Poll the status of an async transcript export job.

When status is completed the response includes the download_url (and storage_path) written by the worker; when failed see error_message.

```php
$result = $sendseven->conversations()->getTranscriptExport(conversationId: 'conversation_id', jobId: 'job_id');
```

- Scopes: `conversations:read`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$conversationId` | `string` | yes |  |
| `$jobId` | `string` | yes |  |

Returns `TranscriptExportJob`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Conversations/get_transcript_export_api_v1_conversations__conversation_id__transcript__job_id__get)
